# Vendored source provenance

This package is derived from `orbitrelaylabs/skills` commit
`fd333e2415015d8588314558420ef21f3134eb8b`.

The vendored copy keeps the two self-contained transaction Skill bundles reviewable in this
repository and replaces the former external browser integration with the project-owned isolated
Chrome/CDP runtime. Update the recorded commit, rebuild both bundles, and run both repository
check suites when refreshing this directory.
